title: Sum of Digits
description: Write a function `sum_of_digits(n: int) -> int` that returns the sum of the decimal digits of a non-negative integer n.
ground_truth_solution:
def sum_of_digits(n: int) -> int:
    return sum(int(d) for d in str(n))

title: First Unique Character Index
description: Write a function `first_unique_char_index(s: str) -> int` that returns the index of the first character in s that does not repeat anywhere else in s. Return -1 if every character repeats or the string is empty.
